conference_positioning.current_if_primary_only: Potential mechanistic/causal contribution but likely vulnerable at NeurIPS/ICLR without replication and faithful NPM/one-shot latent baseline positioning.
conference_positioning.do_not_frame_as: a new generic activation steering algorithm
conference_positioning.high_tier_target: Strongest framing is a causal identification paper about transporting episode-specific procedural state across context reset, with strict nulls, untouched autonomous confirmation/replication, and explicit comparison to agent procedural-memory and one-shot latent-state methods.

defensible_primary_claim_if_all_frozen_g: A replay-paired, episode-specific plan-content residual can be injected once after a true context reset and causally preserve autonomous later procedural continuation beyond immediate next-action copying and matched semantic/activation-energy controls, without repeated steering; evidence is limited to the frozen model/environment/cohort until replicated.
freeze_rule: This novelty/claim boundary is PRE-OUTCOME. After LocalContinuation confirmation, results may weaken claims but may not retroactively broaden novelty or remove identified closest prior art/required controls.

reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.attack: This is just ActAdd/CAA on an agent.
reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.preemption: Center contribution on causal reset-transfer estimand and first-action-excluded autonomous continuation, not vector arithmetic. Include ActAdd/CAA as method ancestry.

reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.attack: NPM already does procedural activation memory.
reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.preemption: Directly compare claim boundaries: NPM learns reusable skill memory from historical experiences; LocalContinuation tests whether same-episode plan content can be transported across a reset with one intervention. Do not call the broad concept new.

reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.attack: One-shot persistence is already KV cache steering / Memory Inception.
reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.preemption: Those intervene in KV/latent attention memory; LocalContinuation intervenes one residual-stream state at reset then uses ordinary evolving KV with no persistent injected memory bank. Include them as nearest one-shot latent-state baselines/positioning.
Teacher-forced matched-state MSA2 is development selection only. Scientific support requires untouched autonomous LCA2; matched-state metrics cannot rescue null autonomous behavior.

reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.attack: Effect is just copying the next action.
reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.preemption: Primary autonomous LCA2 excludes first post-reset action; mandatory late-null preserves exact next-action lexical evidence but deletes later plan structure.

reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.attack: Effect is generic activation energy or topic/task identity.
reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.preemption: Equal-norm random, unrelated-plan, shuffled-plan, generic-history and no-patch controls; every nonzero control norm matched to active residual.

reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.attack: Fresh cohort is outcome-selected after old failure.
reviewer_attacks_and_preemptions.preemption: Old lineage terminally INCONCLUSIVE because whole-task-success eligibility failed before causal grid. New endpoint/population/rules are frozen before any new model/environment outcomes and exclude all previously exposed paths.
Keep primary claim scoped. Treat second-model and cross-environment replication as required for strongest top-tier framing, not optional decoration.

sources.relevance: Direct parent problem framing: replay pairing shows plan signal decays rapidly and plan eviction hurts ALFWorld; probe-gated resurfacing does not recover success. Diagnostic/measurement, not content-specific causal transport.
sources.title: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents

sources.relevance: Closest agent-memory competitor. Distills procedural skills from historical contrastive experiences into steering vectors and applies activation steering across agent benchmarks. Establishes implicit activation steering as procedural memory; therefore PlanCarry cannot claim that concept broadly.
sources.title: Neural Procedural Memory: Empowering LLM Agents with Implicit Activation Steering
